stages.reference: Create a close material reference for the bottom face of a thick desert cactus in a harsh grounded dark-fantasy ecosystem. This is the older basal cut surface where tough green outer tissue transitions into pale fibrous water-storing flesh and a denser central vascular structure. Soil contact and age should leave restrained dry brown scarring around the base without making it rotten. Use muted green, pale desaturated interior flesh and dusty tan scars. Avoid flower imagery, juicy fruit appearance, wood-like tree rings or graphic botanical diagrams. Make the face feel succulent, fibrous and adapted to drought.
